newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Latvia urges NATO not to close door to membership.
newsitem.headline: Latvia urges NATO not to close door to membership.

text.p: Latvia's Foreign Minister Valdis Birkavs urged NATO on Wednesday not to close the door on the eastern European countries which will not win alliance membership at the first go.

"A division between the have-gots and have-nots may lead to further misperceptions and undesirable reactions, the answer to those who shall not be among them first should be 'No, not yet,' not 'no'," he told NATO's 16 ambassadors.

Birkavs cautioned NATO against making any more concessions to Russia to secure approval for the alliance's planned eastwards enlargement and called for closer military ties between NATO and its partnership countries.
"Is it appropriate to offer greater opportunities for joint decision-making to a country which questions the meaning of the alliance's existence and clearly opposes its enlargement?" he said.
Poland, Hungary and the Czech Republic are likely to be invited to join the military alliance at a special summit in Madrid next July.
The three Baltic states, all former republics of the defunct Soviet Union, are expected to be left out, partly out of fear of provoking a furious Russian reaction.
Latvia was the last of 12 candidate countries invited to NATO's Brussels headquarters to make a case for their inclusion in the first round.
